name: StackingDAO
description: Liquid staking on Stacks. Agents can deposit STX for stSTX (STX yield in the exchange rate) or stSTXbtc (1:1 with STX, yield paid in sBTC), deposit sBTC for stBTC, swap stSTX <> stSTXbtc fee-free, and exit through an instant (1% fee, idle liquidity) or cooldown withdrawal that mints a claim NFT.

keyFunctions.description: Stake STX for stSTX. stx-amount in micro-STX (1 STX = 1000000). Transfers STX from tx-sender (add an STX post-condition) and mints stSTX = stx-amount * 1e6 / get-stx-per-ststx-up. Reverts with err u26007 if fewer than min-shares-out micro-stSTX would be minted (0 = no slippage check). Returns (ok ststx-amount).

Start a standard withdrawal of ststx-amount micro-stSTX. Moves your stSTX to the core, locks STX at the current ratio and mints a withdrawal NFT (ststx-withdraw-nft-v4) to you. Returns (ok nft-id). Claimable after a fixed cooldown (currently 2,100 Bitcoin blocks, about two weeks; see withdraw-data-stx-v2.get-withdraw-unlock-burn-height).

Claim STX for a withdrawal NFT once burn-block-height >= its unlock-burn-height. tx-sender must own the NFT (err u26003 otherwise; err u26002 if still locked). Burns the NFT and the escrowed stSTX, sends STX. Returns (ok {stx-user, stx-fee}).

Instant unstake: burns ststx-amount micro-stSTX and pays STX from idle reserve liquidity right away, minus the idle fee (get-withdraw-idle-fee, 100 bps = 1% at research time). Reverts err u26006 if the reserve lacks idle STX. Returns (ok {stx-user, stx-fee}).
true if deposits are paused by governance. Also get-shutdown-init-withdraw(), get-shutdown-withdraw(), get-shutdown-withdraw-idle(). All false at research time.
Instant-unstake fee in basis points (u100 = 1%).
Fee on standard withdrawals in basis points (u0 at research time).
micro-STX backing one stSTX, scaled by 1e6 (e.g. u1199681 = 1.199681 STX per stSTX at research time). Rounded down; use for redemption value and to size min-shares-out.
Same ratio rounded up; this is the value deposit() divides by.
stSTX balance in micro-stSTX (6 decimals). Value-accruing (non-rebasing) token.
Total stSTX supply (6 decimals).

Stake micro-STX and receive the same amount of stSTXbtc (minted 1:1). Yield is paid in sBTC via ststxbtc-tracking-v2, not through a ratio. Returns (ok stx-amount).

Start a standard withdrawal (1 stSTXbtc = 1 STX). Mints a ststxbtc-withdraw-nft-v3 to you; returns (ok nft-id). Cooldown is currently 2,100 Bitcoin blocks (ststxbtc-data-v2.get-withdraw-cooldown-blocks).
Claim STX for an unlocked withdrawal NFT you own. Returns (ok {stx-user, stx-fee}).
Instant unstake from idle STX minus the idle fee (1% at research time). Returns (ok {stx-user, stx-fee}).
Pause flag for deposits (also get-shutdown-init-withdraw / -withdraw / -withdraw-idle).
Instant-unstake fee in basis points.
stSTXbtc balance (6 decimals, 1:1 with STX).

Start a standard withdrawal; mints a stbtc-withdraw-nft to you, returns (ok nft-id). Cooldown currently 4,200 Bitcoin blocks (about four weeks; withdraw-data-stbtc.get-withdraw-cooldown-blocks).
Claim sBTC for an unlocked withdrawal NFT you own.
Instant withdrawal from idle sBTC, minus the idle fee (1% at research time), if liquidity is available.

Non-custodial native stacking: stakes amount-ustx of your own STX via PoX-5 with StackingDAO's native-pool signer manager (pass SP4SZE494VC2YC5JYG7AYFQ44F5Q4PYV7DVMDPBG.native-pool-signer-manager; any other reverts err u36002) for num-cycles. STX stays locked in your wallet; no liquid token. Rewards in BTC/sBTC; 5% fee per docs FAQ.

actions.name: stake STX for stSTX
actions.description: Liquid-stake STX, yield compounds into the stSTX/STX ratio.
actions.how: Read data-stx-v2.get-stx-per-ststx; min = stx-amount*1e6/ratio minus a small buffer; call stacking-dao-core-stx-v2.deposit(stx-amount, min) with an STX post-condition for stx-amount.

actions.name: stake STX for stSTXbtc
actions.description: Liquid-stake STX and earn sBTC rewards.

actions.name: stake sBTC for stBTC
actions.how: Read data-stbtc-v1.get-sbtc-per-stbtc; call stacking-dao-core-stbtc-v1.deposit(sbtc-amount, min) with an sBTC post-condition.

actions.name: instant unstake
actions.description: Exit immediately for a 1% fee if idle liquidity exists.
actions.how: core.withdraw-idle(amount) on the matching core contract. Alternative: sell on a Stacks DEX (Bitflow), price may differ.

actions.name: standard unstake
actions.description: Exit at full ratio after the cooldown.
actions.how: core.init-withdraw(amount) -> nft-id; wait until burn-block-height >= withdraw-data .get-withdrawals-by-nft(nft-id).unlock-burn-height (about 2 weeks for stSTX/stSTXbtc, about 4 weeks for stBTC); then core.withdraw(nft-id) from the NFT owner.

risks: Standard withdrawals take a fixed cooldown: 2,100 Bitcoin blocks (~2 weeks) for stSTX/stSTXbtc and 4,200 (~4 weeks) for stBTC at research time; governance can lengthen it (minimum 2,100 on mainnet). The withdrawal NFT must not be transferred/sold by mistake: only its owner can claim.
Instant unstake charges a 1% fee and only works while the reserve holds enough idle liquidity.

Governance (dao / dao-multisig / dao-executor) can pause deposits and each withdrawal path, change fees, and upgrade contracts by activating new versions; versioned contract names (e.g. core-stx-v2 replaced core-v6) mean integrations must follow the docs.
stBTC depends on the external sBTC token and peg (SM3VDXK3WZZSA84XXFKAFAF15NNZX32CTSG82JFQ4.sbtc-token), outside StackingDAO's control.
Secondary-market prices of stSTX/stSTXbtc on DEXs can deviate from the protocol ratio.
Audited by Clarity Alliance (PoX-5 contracts and earlier versions) and CoinFabrik; Immunefi bug bounty up to $100k. Residents of restricted countries are barred from the app.
notes: Stacks is a Clarity-VM chain (non-EVM), so vm is 'mixed' and chainId is null; addresses are Clarity contract principals (deployer.contract-name), all deployed by SP4SZE494VC2YC5JYG7AYFQ44F5Q4PYV7DVMDPBG. Function signatures are in Clarity form (name(arg type, ...)); call them with a Stacks contract-call transaction and add post-conditions for STX/sBTC/token transfers. Core, data and swap addresses come from the docs' Core Contracts pages; tokens, NFTs, tracker, withdraw-data and native pool come from the official mainnet deployment list (61 contracts) in StackingDAO/stackingdao-smart-contracts. Each listed contract was confirmed to exist via the Hiro API and live parameters (pause flags all false, idle fee 1%, ratios, cooldowns) were read on 2026-11-24. Internal contracts (reserves, strategy, stakers, signer managers, rewards, governance) are left out; see the mainnet README for them. Older cores (stacking-dao-core-v6, stacking-dao-core-btc-v3, swap-ststx-ststxbtc-v2) are superseded and should not be used.
